content.problemStatement: Complete the code snippet below to print all the elements in an array whose values are lesser than a key element in an unsorted array.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Print all elements in array strictly less than K in original order.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    n = int(toks[0])
    arr = [int(x) for x in toks[1:n+1]]
    k = int(toks[n+1])
    sub = [str(x) for x in arr if x < k]
    print(" ".join(sub))
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

solution.editorial: Iterate through elements, printing those strictly less than K separated by space.
